Jain Clinical Antibody Polyreactivity Dataset (Novo Nordisk Parity Benchmark)
	


	
		
	
	
		Dataset Summary
	

This dataset contains 86 clinical-stage antibody heavy chain variable domain (VH) sequences with binary polyreactivity labels, preprocessed to reproduce the benchmark results from Sakhnini et al. 2025 (Novo Nordisk & University of Cambridge). The original dataset was published by Jain et al. 2017 and contains biophysical measurements for 137 FDA-approved or late-stage… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hugging-science/jain-clinical-antibody-polyreactivity.
